message: A project can be divided into independent jobs, worked on at the same time, and brought together as one finished deliverable.
audience: People curious about how parallel AI agents work together
claims: A project is divided into independent jobs.
The jobs are worked on concurrently by multiple agents.
The completed work is assembled into one finished deliverable and handed over.
illustrative_assumptions: A paper book workshop is an illustrative metaphor for parallel AI-agent collaboration.
The project is simplified into three jobs: preparing a cover, pages, and binding.
The three jobs are treated as independent for this example, though real jobs may exchange information or have dependencies.
Overlapping actions illustrate concurrency, not equal workload or measured speedup.
ending_action: Receiving hands take the finished book's weight, and the same book withdraws with them during a brief final hold.

beats.action: The folio unfolds and distributes its cover, pages, and binding into three separate Bot grips.
beats.before_after: One intact folio becomes three traceable job pieces held by three workers.
beats.focal_detail: The divided project seal remains visible across the separated components.
beats.consequence: Each Bot receives a distinct job piece.
beats.narration: The project splits, sending three jobs to three Bots.
beats.caption: Dividing the project

beats.subject: Cover, pages, and binding jobs
beats.action: All three Bots work simultaneously: folding the cover, pressing the pages, and carrying the binding toward assembly.
beats.before_after: A flat cover, uneven pages, and curled binding become a creased cover, aligned stack, and positioned binding.
beats.focal_detail: All three overlapping operations and their persistent component colors remain visible together.
beats.consequence: The three worked pieces reach the shared assembly area.
beats.narration: They work in parallel, folding, pressing, and carrying each piece toward shared assembly.
beats.caption: Working at the same time
